faq.a1: Aura is a connected salon operating system. Owner CRM and POS, pay-at-salon customer booking, qualified staff operations, inventory, finance and branch-aware records are designed around the same salon day.
faq.a10: Subscription payment methods and payment-provider details are confirmed in the proposal. Customer bookings shown on this site use the pay-at-salon flow.
faq.a11: Yes. Growth and Enterprise plans include attendance tracking, shift scheduling, commission calculation, and payroll processing. Aura calculates PF, ESI, TDS, professional tax, gratuity and bonus where applicable.
faq.a12: White-label branding -- custom domain, logo, colors -- is available on the Enterprise plan. The customer-facing booking portal can carry your salon's brand identity.
faq.a2: Aura plans are structured for a single branch, growing operations up to five branches, and proposal-based enterprise operations. Confirm fit and final scope in a demo and proposal.
faq.a3: Operational records carry tenant and branch context. Access is designed around authorised roles and locations; exact cross-branch permissions and settlement rules should be verified for your configuration.
faq.a4: Yes. Aura generates GST-ready invoices with HSN/SAC context, calculates CGST/SGST or IGST, and creates GST report summaries. Filing is done through your CA or the government portal -- Aura prepares the data.
faq.a5: Yes. The current public booking story is pay at salon: clients choose a service, professional and slot, then confirm without online prepayment.
faq.a6: The Staff App supports a qualified workday journey. Secure attendance is Android-only when owner policy and configuration enable it. Roster, tasks, leave, communication and permitted attribution context are included in the current story; complete iOS attendance is not claimed.
faq.a7: Aura is designed around tenant and branch isolation, role-based access and audit trails. Hosting, encryption, backup, retention and compliance commitments are confirmed in the proposal and data-processing terms.
faq.a8: Data preparation and agreed imports are part of the onboarding process. Source formats, validation, correction responsibility and migration scope are confirmed during assessment.
faq.a9: Request a demo. The team will review your workflow, then confirm assessment, data preparation, configuration, role training, go-live checks and any suitable trial access in the proposal.

home.faq.a1: Yes. Aura provides guided migration support to import your existing clients, service menus, inventory catalog, and staff lists from Excel, CSV, or other legacy systems so you can switch with zero downtime.
home.faq.a10: Yes. You can upgrade or adjust your branch count as your business expands. Upgrades take effect immediately with pro-rated billing.
home.faq.a2: Yes. Aura natively supports multi-branch operations. You get a central owner dashboard with consolidated revenue reports, cross-branch loyalty points, and stock transfers between locations.
home.faq.a3: Yes. Aura is engineered specifically for Indian tax regulations with itemized CGST/SGST splits, customizable HSN/SAC codes, B2B/B2C invoicing, and one-click export files formatted for your CA.
home.faq.a4: Yes. Aura has granular role-based access control. You can grant stylists access to only their bookings and commissions, allow front desk to handle billing, while keeping overall business margins and audit logs restricted to owners.
home.faq.a5: Yes. Aura includes a branded online booking portal where clients can select services, pick their preferred stylist, choose a time slot, and opt for seamless pay-at-salon checkout.
home.faq.a6: Yes. You can configure tiered memberships, bundled service packages, prepaid wallet top-up bonuses, and automated WhatsApp expiry notifications.
home.faq.a7: Yes. Aura is fully responsive and cloud-accessible across iPads, Android tablets, laptops, and smartphones with dedicated views for salon owners, stylists, and receptionists.
home.faq.a8: Yes. Our team assists with initial account configuration, service menu setup, staff training, and test billing to ensure your team is completely confident from day one.
home.faq.a9: We provide dedicated WhatsApp, phone, and email support during business hours to ensure your front desk never experiences disruptions during peak salon rush hours.
